basic_info.description: Welcome to The Brannan! This luxurious 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom residence captivates with it's breathtaking Bay Bridge as well as cityscape views. It offers an open and airy layout with refined details throughout giving this residence the perfect feel of home. The kitchen is an entertainer's dream equipped with the finest of Thermador appliances to accomodate those special gatherings. The primary and secondary bedrooms are both thoughtfully designed as en-suites & the third bedroom can be used as an office space with a custom made desk that fits the room perfectly for those work at home days. With hardwood floors throughout, other highlights include a laundry room with stainless steel sink included, spacious closets, and additional storage. The Brannan is not only known for it's beautiful design but also for the community's amenities which include a heated outdoor swimming pool, hot tub, a barbecue area, & a full gym with yoga studio included. The Brannan provides the finest of San Francisco living with the views to match.
